tolerances.notes: Volume and surface area use SolidCraft's default relative tolerance of 1e-3. Bounding box and centre of mass use the looser of 0.05 mm (the reference-parts scorecard floor; an exact OCCT bbox on a cylinder is about 0.024 mm) and 1e-3 of the expected bbox diagonal (SolidCraft's absolute rule).
